description: This Java class implements an Android Service called AlarmService that manages background tasks, notifications, and inter-process communication via Binder. It starts a thread that waits for 15 seconds, then stops itself, and provides a binder for clients.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages a background thread, notifications, and provides a Binder for IPC.

classes.name: AlarmBinder
classes.description: A concrete subclass of Binder used for IPC, with an overridden onTransact method.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification, and starts a background thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up notifications and shows a toast when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification indicating the service is running, with an intent to launch AlarmActivity.
